simplemermaid-button-fullscreen: Tooltip/aria-label for the button that enters fullscreen view of a mermaid diagram.
simplemermaid-button-fullscreen-exit: Tooltip/aria-label for the button that exits fullscreen view of a mermaid diagram.
simplemermaid-button-copy: Tooltip/aria-label for the button that copies the mermaid source code to the clipboard.
simplemermaid-button-copied: Transient tooltip on the copy button right after a successful clipboard copy. {{Identical|Copied}}
simplemermaid-button-zoom-in: Tooltip/aria-label for the zoom-in button shown in fullscreen view.
simplemermaid-button-zoom-out: Tooltip/aria-label for the zoom-out button shown in fullscreen view.
simplemermaid-button-pan-up: Tooltip/aria-label for the pan-up button on the pan pad in fullscreen view.
simplemermaid-button-pan-down: Tooltip/aria-label for the pan-down button on the pan pad in fullscreen view.
simplemermaid-button-pan-left: Tooltip/aria-label for the pan-left button on the pan pad in fullscreen view.
simplemermaid-button-pan-right: Tooltip/aria-label for the pan-right button on the pan pad in fullscreen view.
simplemermaid-button-reset: Tooltip/aria-label for the button that resets the view (center + zoom 100%) in fullscreen.
simplemermaid-ve-empty: Placeholder shown inside the VisualEditor preview when a <mermaid> block has no source text.
simplemermaid-ve-inspector-title: Title of the VisualEditor inspector dialog used to edit a mermaid diagram.
